about.description: OGY is the utility and governance token of ORIGYN, a provenance and authenticity infrastructure focused on high-value real-world assets such as luxury goods, art, and collectibles. ORIGYN centers on creating tamper-resistant digital certificates that track an item’s identity, history, and ownership, enabling verification and more credible secondary-market trading. OGY is used across the ecosystem for participation, incentives, and governance over how certification and marketplace primitives evolve.
